scope.transport: Every request-serving Neon client is created by the shared HTTP factory, which adds a fresh 10-second timeout and preserves caller cancellation.
scope.retrySafety: The HTTP transport makes one attempt only. Uncertain writes never retry at transport level; durable cron replay remains behind the existing idempotency, lease, and fence boundary.
scope.atomicity: Server routes use one-shot HTTP operations. Coupled writes must be one statement, a database function, or a Neon non-interactive transaction batch; interactive sessions are not used.
scope.failureInjection: Focused unit tests inject timeout, transient transport failure, and caller cancellation without connecting to Neon.
